An independently reviewed source/q rights issuer that accounts for all measured/collision/off-ledger aliases and keeps q outside student base rights, or correctly returns NOT_ESTIMABLE; such an issuer must commit BEFORE observing target results.

A versioned CaseBundle real-path shape separating PRIVATE physical total and PUBLIC base_rights_normalization_depth, with source q/identity binding and derived digest re-verification, compatible with current Task2/Task5 and no silent weakening.

Hostile synthetic tests prove measured-zero vs structurally unavailable, wrong/right query, q-in-base refusal, off-ledger hidden mass refusal, donor alias spoof rejection, post-hoc policy swap, mismatched private total, no D1 full total leakage.

A retrospective inventory of old source artifacts confirms each indispensable field is missing/non-derivable; ONLY THEN a separate prospective owner-scope within earlier one-block ceiling can be considered.

2. Populate field coverage from existing trusted receipts without any numeric data read
3. If exact indispensable missing trust edge proven, specify a minimal new binding/validator against existing code, with fail-closed synthetic fixtures
4. Independent reviewer challenge of that new code; no experiment, fitting, or additional source reads
5. Only if artifacts cannot yield indispensable per-cell values, propose a separately reviewed, prospective read under existing one-block owner scope; no automatic execute
